assets.name: CanneryFloorAlbedo

Primary request: 2 metres of muted pale neutral grey worn non-slip resin flooring in a modest fish cannery. Fine aggregate, broad quiet rubbed patches, faint irregular scuffs, sparse old mineral marks. Washable and maintained. No puddles, no markings, no grout grid, no large damage; local wetness and wear will be placed in the game. Composition: perpendicular orthographic view of a flat surface filling the whole image edge to edge, tile seamlessly in both axes. Style: restrained realistic material simplified for a videogame, readable quiet broad forms, low contrast and fine surface character. Lighting: fully flat diffuse albedo, no directional lighting, gradient, baked shadows, ambient occlusion, perspective or specular reflection. Neutral light base suitable for multiplication by muted material tint. No text, watermark, frame, sheet grid or other objects. Output only the texture image.
